canonical.title: IT conferences and tech events in Copenhagen

parent.title: A Copenhagen weekend around a Michelin dinner

siblings.title: Things to do in Copenhagen
siblings.summary: A weekend around a Michelin dinner: pick the central walking loop on day one, one neighbourhood + one museum on day two, Louisiana as the single must-do day-trip. Skip the Little Mermaid.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Copenhagen
siblings.summary: Eight restaurants hold two or three Michelin stars in Copenhagen right now — what each is, what it costs, and which you can actually book for a weekend.

sources.title: GOTO Copenhagen
sources.claim: GOTO Copenhagen 2026 runs Sep 28–Oct 2 at TAP1, ~1200 attendees, 'Engineering for Reality' theme, speakers include Kent Beck, Dave Thomas, Troy Hunt, Sam Newman.

sources.title: NDC Copenhagen
sources.claim: NDC Copenhagen 2026 runs Jun 1–4 at Øksnehallen in Kødbyen with 55 speakers, 65 sessions, 7 workshops.

sources.title: TechBBQ
sources.claim: TechBBQ 2026 is the Nordic startup/scale-up summit, Aug 26–27 at Bella Center, 10,000+ attendees, 1,500+ investors.

sources.title: Nordic Fintech Week
sources.claim: Nordic Fintech Week 2026 runs Sep 21–25 in Copenhagen with conference days Sep 23–24.

sources.title: Future Product Days
sources.claim: Future Product Days 2026 runs Sep 22–24 at Lokomotivværkstedet with 100+ speakers, 7 stages, 9,000+ attendees, four tracks including AI.

sources.title: European Power Platform Conference
sources.claim: EPPC 2026 runs Jun 29–Jul 2 at Bella Center, 2,000+ developers/makers/IT pros.

sources.title: Codegarden (Umbraco)
sources.claim: Codegarden 2026 runs Jun 10–11 at Øksnehallen and CPH Conference, 4 stages, in-person + online.

sources.title: Driving IT (IDA)
sources.claim: Driving IT 2026 is IDA's one-day, 4-track IT conference on Oct 30 at IDA Conference, Kalvebod Brygge.

sources.title: Cloud Native Denmark
sources.claim: Cloud Native Denmark 2026 runs Nov 19–20 at Scandic Copenhagen, community-driven Kubernetes/cloud-native conference.

sources.title: Laravel Live Denmark
sources.claim: Laravel Live Denmark 2026 runs Aug 20–21 at Werkstatt on Reffen with 16 speakers and 300+ attendees.

sources.title: dev.events — Copenhagen
sources.claim: Aggregated dev.events listing for 2026 Copenhagen conferences includes Data Platform Next Step (Jun 1–2), Tech Passion Day (Sep 16), Directions for Enterprise (Sep 23–25), Future Coding Day (Sep 24).

sources.title: Copenhagen .NET User Group
sources.claim: CNUG has 3,649 members, free monthly meetups, hosted at rotating company offices.

sources.title: CopenhagenJS
sources.claim: CopenhagenJS is a monthly JS meetup hosted at friendly companies, format is two community talks.

sources.title: PyData Copenhagen
sources.claim: PyData Copenhagen runs Python/data-science meetups in the city.

sources.title: EU-Startups — Danish startups 2026
sources.claim: Copenhagen is Europe's third-largest AI hub; Denmark's startup ecosystem grew 31.3% Apr 2024–Apr 2025; Pleo leads with >$470M funding.

sources.title: Copenhagen Fintech — Events
sources.claim: Copenhagen Fintech runs additional 2026 fintech events including General Assembly (May 26), 3xF and Demo Day: Digital Assets (Jun 9), Singapore and Slush delegations (Nov 18).

sources.title: Laravel News — Laravel Live Denmark 2026
sources.claim: Laravel Live Denmark 2026 announced fireside chat between Taylor Otwell and DHH.

sources.title: Startup Guide — Copenhagen
sources.claim: Copenhagen's tech ecosystem is supported by accelerators including Accelerace, Founders House, and Copenhagen Fintech, with ~76,000 university students.

sources.title: Laravel Copenhagen meetup
sources.claim: Laravel Copenhagen — local node behind Laravel Live Denmark.
